steps.content: [Dark alley]
As the datura scent fades, more and more townsfolk are snapping out of their numbed state.
Fresh blood mingles with dried stains. Bodies of humans and monsters alike are strewn all over the once-pristine streets.

steps.speaker: Townie A
steps.content: The town... it's overrun with monsters... How did this happen...

steps.speaker: Townie A
steps.content: Where did they come from... What... what do they want...

steps.speaker: Townie B
steps.content: Will they find us here? What do we do? ...Oh god, what are we supposed to do?
Panic strikes the helpless folks as chaos engulfs the town. Stripped of the soothing floral scent, their already fragile minds are crumbling and inching close to hysteria.

steps.speaker: Townie C
steps.content: Vautour Bleu... Miss Vautour Bleu will come to save us, right?

steps.speaker: Townie A
steps.content: That's right, we can still count on Vautour Bleu! She'll get rid of these monsters. She'll protect our town!
At the mention of Vautour Bleu's name, a glimmer of hope spreads through the crowd. They believe she'll protect Désir and everyone, just as she has before.
But one of them recoils, his face suddenly twisting in terror upon hearing Vautour Bleu's name.

steps.speaker: Townie B
steps.content: I don't know... I don't know... Vautour Bleu... Vautour Bleu...

steps.speaker: Townie A
steps.content: What's wrong? Zindy, are you alright?
The one named Zindy shakes his head, muttering broken sentences as if in great shock.

steps.speaker: Zindy
steps.content: I... I can hear the monsters... The monsters are talking... they're saying...

steps.speaker: Zindy
steps.content: Liar... Liar... Vautour Bleu is a liar... She's...

steps.speaker: Townie A
steps.content: What do you mean, liar? Say it clear!
The girl shakes Zindy's shoulders to snap him out of daze, but Zindy just keeps mumbling the same few garbled sentences, his face pale.

steps.speaker: Zindy
steps.content: It says... It's Noffie... Noffie... That monster says it's Noffie!

steps.speaker: Townie A
steps.content: Didn't Noffie leave for DisCity? Miss Vautour Bleu told us she found him work in Eastside...
Huddling together, the townsfolk begin to recall the incoherent ramblings of the monsters outside.

steps.speaker: Zindy
steps.content: Has Vautour Bleu been lying to us all along...

steps.speaker: Townie A
steps.content: No! That's impossible! How dare you spout such nonsense!!!

steps.speaker: Townie A
steps.content: Miss Vautour Bleu would never lie to us! Never!
The monsters are lurking closer like bloodthirsty beasts battering at the door of a cage, the circle they form gradually tightening.

steps.speaker: Monster
steps.content: Destroy... Désir... Destroy everything!!!

steps.speaker: Townie C
steps.content: That voice... Darcy, is that you? Why... why are you here?
Seemingly responding, the monster stiffly twists its neck at an inhuman angle, fixing its hollow gaze on the one who called it name.
A tentacle coils around the person's leg, while another lashes toward an eye, ignoring the desperate screams of its former friend...

steps.speaker: Townie A
steps.content: No! Stay away from me...!!! NO!!!
In a flash, the tentacles are severed. The monster unleashes a bloodcurdling shriek.
Through the splashing blood, a calm figure steps forward, standing before the terrified townsfolk.

steps.speaker: Townie A
steps.content: You're... you're the newcomer...
I'm the MBCC's Chief from DisCity. I'm here to help you.
